summary: Blended claim value overstated roughly tenfold
detail: Derivation produced $9,205 average allowed per claim. Benchmarking against a health system's expected per-claim value (roughly $400-$1,500) showed this to be implausible by an order of magnitude. Outpatient contributed $8,138 of the $9,205.
root_cause: The CMS Medicare Outpatient Hospitals file covers Comprehensive APCs only: 72 procedural APC groups (observation, musculoskeletal, endoscopy, intraocular, endovascular) averaging $5,123 per service. It excludes routine outpatient volume (laboratory, imaging, clinic, therapy), which is the overwhelming majority of outpatient claim count. Treating the C-APC average as the outpatient average is a scope error, not an arithmetic error.
resolution: Outpatient split into two buckets. Procedural bucket priced from observed C-APC data at 1.5% of claim mix; ancillary bucket derived from the professional per-line rate with a 1.9x facility uplift at 30% of claim mix. Blended value corrected to $1,336.32. Scope limitation logged as DQ-010 and surfaced in the dashboard Method tab.

summary: Net appeal recovery computed as negative across all categories
detail: Recovery model returned -$406,960 net appeal recovery, implying no denial is ever worth appealing, which contradicts the observed 39.7% overturn rate.
root_cause: Average allowed amount per claim was initially set to $246, a figure drawn from physician professional services. Applied to a 420-bed health system whose claim mix includes inpatient and hospital outpatient, it understated claim value by roughly 5x, making every appeal uneconomic against its labour cost.
resolution: Replaced the asserted constant with a derivation from CMS DY2024 payment files (see DEF-001). Post-correction, 5 of 10 categories return positive ROI, which is the expected and defensible result: low-effort administrative appeals pay, high-effort clinical appeals on low-value claims do not.

summary: Modelled denial loss more than double the published industry benchmark
detail: Total annual opportunity computed as $24.7M against $245.9M of gross claim value, or roughly 10% of revenue. Published benchmarks place denial-driven loss at 3-5% of net patient revenue.
root_cause: The model treated the full allowed amount of a denied claim as at risk. A claim-level denial event is not a total loss: many denials are line-level, partial, duplicate submissions, coordination-of-benefits routing, or zero-dollar administrative denials that were never going to pay in full.
resolution: Introduced denial_value_at_risk_share as an explicit assumption (base 0.25, range 0.15-0.40) and added BRD-024, a calibration gate that compares modelled loss to the 3-5% band and fails visibly when outside it. Post-fix modelled loss is 4.12%, mid-band. The gate now runs on every pipeline execution and every dashboard interaction.

summary: National claim volume overstated 84x in first aggregation
detail: Summing issuer_claims_received across the plan-grain panel produced 157 billion claims against a true 1.88 billion.
root_cause: Issuer-level measures are denormalized across every plan row belonging to that issuer in the source workbooks. An issuer with 84 plans repeats its issuer-level totals 84 times. Summing at plan grain multiplies each issuer's volume by its plan count.
resolution: Issuer panel deduplicated to issuer-year grain before any issuer-level aggregation. Logged as DQ-009 with severity Critical because it produces a plausible-looking number rather than an obvious error. TC-004 now asserts the deduplication and quantifies the overstatement a naive build would produce.

summary: PY2024 out-of-network denial column silently dropped on rename
detail: The column Issuer_Claims_Denied_Out_of_Network was absent from the PY2024 harmonized output while present in PY2025 and PY2026.
root_cause: CMS shipped the PY2024 workbook with a stray trailing double quote in the header: Issuer_Claims_Denied_Out_of_Network" — so the rename map did not match it and the column was dropped without error.
resolution: Added an explicit mapping for the malformed header in config.COLUMN_MAP alongside the clean one. Added a header-integrity check in harmonize.load_year that logs any header ending in a quote character as DQ-003 severity High, so a future recurrence surfaces rather than silently dropping data.

summary: Denial reason categories do not reconcile to reported total denials for most plan-years
detail: Only 4,640 of 25,666 plan-years (18%) have reason categories summing to reported total denials within 2%. Tested against in-network, out-of-network, issuer-level, and combined denominators; total (in + out) was the best match in every schema generation, confirming the mapping is correct.
root_cause: Source data limitation, not a mapping defect. Issuer self-reported reason detail is internally inconsistent: some plans report suppressed cells that break the sum, others report reason counts exceeding stated totals by up to 2x.
resolution: Accepted as a documented constraint rather than fixed. Reason-mix analysis restricted to reconciling plan-years via a reason_reconciles flag; volume analysis uses all rows. Rescaling the non-reconciling majority was rejected because it would manufacture precision the source does not support. Disclosed in the dashboard Data Quality tab.

summary: Sensitivity tornado failed to render on the dashboard Method tab
detail: AttributeError: 'function' object has no attribute 'apply' when ordering assumptions by swing magnitude.
root_cause: A DataFrame column was named pct_change, which shadows the built-in DataFrame.pct_change method. Attribute-style access resolved to the method rather than the column.
resolution: Column renamed to pct_delta and accessed via bracket notation. Verified the Method tab renders end to end in the browser.

summary: Deprecation warnings on every dashboard render
detail: Streamlit emitted 'Please replace use_container_width with width' for 15 calls, scheduled for removal after 2025-12-31.
root_cause: API deprecation in the installed Streamlit version.
resolution: All 15 call sites migrated to width="stretch". Console is clean on render.
